jobs.description: Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide. Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role. NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position. Key job responsibilities • Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required • Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors • Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities • Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues • Helping to train and onboard new team members Physical requirements: • Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds • Working in cramped and/or elevated locations • Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching • Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day • Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation • Work in a noisy environment • Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts). This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: • Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed • Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational • Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. A day in the life As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you: • Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution • Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context • Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Job Title:

Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Obra - Development Manager

Company:

Prologis

Missão da Posição:

O Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Galpões (Development Manager) da Prologis atua como líder multifuncional no ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de ativos logísticos. Isso inclui liderar tecnicamente a aquisição de terrenos (em parceria com a área de Investimentos), aprovação de projetos, orçamentação, coordenação da construção e entrega final ao cliente. A função exige visão estratégica, capacidade de articulação com diversas áreas e foco em execução de alto padrão, sustentabilidade e retorno financeiro.

Diretora de Desenvolvimento.

Local de Trabalho

São Paulo-SP, Brasil.

Responsabilidades Principais

Estratégia e Planejamento

Conduzir estudos de viabilidade financeira para novos desenvolvimentos.

Aprovações, Licenciamentos e Relacionamento Institucional:

• Liderar o processo de aprovação de projetos junto a prefeituras, órgãos ambientais, utilities e demais stakeholders públicos.
• Participar de reuniões com autoridades regulatórias e urbanísticas.
• Definir a estratégia das aprovações e mitigar riscos regulatórios
• Trabalhar com escritórios de arquitetura, urbanismo e direito regulatório para garantir conformidade com normas locais

Execução e Gerenciamento de Projetos:
• Supervisionar todas as fases do projeto: design, orçamento, licitação, contratação, cronograma e execução da obra

• Liderar a estratégia de cronograma e obra em parceria aos consultores

• Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time de Construction, garantindo controle rigoroso de qualidade, tempo e custo.
• Coordenar escopos e entregas com engenheiros civis, elétricos, ambientais e técnicos externos.

Relacionamento com Clientes:
• Atuar como interface com clientes em projetos BTS ou sob demanda, garantindo que os requisitos técnicos e operacionais sejam incorporados ao projeto.
• Atuar junto ao time de Leasing para fornecer embasamento técnico para os contratos de aluguéis.(LOIs, lease agreements, etc.)

Gestão Financeira e Compliance:
• Acompanhar CAPEX, forecast e budget dos projetos, com reporte contínuo ao time financeiro.
• Garantir aderência às políticas internas da Prologis, incluindo sustentabilidade, EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) e governança.

Pós-entrega e Avaliação:
• Coordenar atividades de encerramento do projeto e entrega do empreendimento para a área de manutenções. Atuar no pós-entrega, para possíveis chamados de garantia
• Avaliar lições aprendidas e propor melhorias contínuas para processos futuros.

Qualificações e Competências:

Formação Acadêmica:
• Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura, Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Negócios Imobiliários (desejável).

Experiência:
• Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento imobiliário e construção logística/industrial • Histórico comprovado de entrega de projetos industriais/logísticos, preferencialmente com grandes clientes multinacionais.
• Familiaridade com processos de licenciamento ambiental, urbano e infraestrutura no Brasil

Competências Técnicas:
Forte domínio de Excel e ferramentas de modelagem financeira.
Experiência com plataformas de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: MS Project, Primavera, Procore).
Conhecimento de normas técnicas de construção, sustentabilidade (LEED, EDGE, etc.) e segurança.

Conhecimento de Autocad e/ou BIM

Soft Skills:
• Liderança colaborativa e capacidade de tomada de decisão sob pressão.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de conflitos.
• Foco em resultados com mentalidade de dono (ownership).
• Inglês avançado (obrigatório); espanhol é um diferencial.

Diferenciais da Prologis:
• Cultura corporativa orientada à inovação, sustentabilidade e impacto global.
• Forte integração entre as áreas (Development, Leasing, Construction, Finance e Legal).
• Projetos com alto padrão técnico e exigência global de qualidade.
• Ambiente dinâmico, meritocrático e com oportunidades internacionais de carreira.

People First

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most - our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and dedicate both time and resources to leadership development. Our team is intentional about cultivating a culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion so that everyone at Prologis feels a sense of belonging.

Full time

Sao Paulo, Brazil

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic sells Claude through partners as well as directly. In the public sector, those partners matter more than anywhere else. As Channel Partner Manager, Public Sector, you will own Anthropic's reseller and distributor relationships across US federal, state and local government, and you will build the operations that let those partners transact with us quickly and cleanly.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between two kinds of work. The first is partner management. You will be the primary Anthropic contact for our public sector partners, agree on a joint plan with each of them, and work with our public sector account teams so that partner and direct motions support each other rather than collide. The second is channel operations. You will onboard new partners, instance an agreement for each of them, run deal registration, administer rebates, and keep the program's processes and records in order.

Every partner adds a fixed amount of operational work regardless of revenue, so the processes you build will determine how quickly public sector customers can buy. Much of this does not exist at Anthropic yet, and building it to a standard our partners and teams can rely on will be a large part of your first year.

You will work closely with Legal, Finance and with our public sector sales team on pipeline. You will also work with the public sector teams at the cloud providers and through cloud environments that meet federal security requirements such as FedRAMP.

Key responsibilities

• Own Anthropic's relationships with our public sector partners, acting as their primary point of contact and building relationships with their public sector and alliance leadership
• Agree on a joint business plan with each partner covering target segments, contract vehicles, pipeline, enablement and marketing, and run regular business reviews against it
• Work with our federal, state and local, and education account teams to align partner and direct motions, clear conflicts early, and route each opportunity through the right partner and contract vehicle
• Run partner onboarding end to end, from application and diligence through agreement execution, enablement and a first transaction
• Own partner agreements with Legal, keeping contract vehicle coverage and program terms current
• Own deal registration for the public sector channel, making sure registrations are submitted, validated and conflict cleared, and that every deal names its end customer
• Manage partner rebates and program incentives with Finance
• Build and run the channel's operating processes, including quoting, order handling and partner reporting, with clear service levels and documentation
• Work with the cloud providers' public sector teams so that partner deals run cleanly through cloud marketplaces and authorized cloud environments
• Forecast and report partner sourced pipeline and resale revenue for the public sector channel, and own that number with the reseller program and public sector sales leadership
• Own partner escalations end to end, from billing and contracting questions to deal conflicts, and resolve them with the right internal owner
• Represent what public sector partners and buyers need to the central reseller program team, and feed what you learn back into how the program works

Minimum qualifications

• 7+ years in channel, partner or alliances roles in enterprise software or cloud, including at least 3 years focused on the US public sector
• Direct experience managing reseller or distributor relationships that sell to government or education buyers
• Working knowledge of how public sector buyers purchase technology, including contract vehicles, two-tier distribution, and the role of resellers in public procurement
• Working fluency in channel program mechanics, including deal registration, partner onboarding, margin and rebates
• Experience running channel or partner operations, including agreements, program administration, reporting, and the systems behind them
• Experience building processes and working rhythms from zero, and comfort joining a new program early
• Clear written and spoken communication with Legal, Finance and Sales teams, and the judgment to hold program rules under commercial pressure
• Excitement about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with FedRAMP and with selling software that runs in authorized cloud environments
• Experience with federal, state and education contract vehicles
• Experience with cloud marketplace resale for public sector buyers, including private offers
• Experience on the reseller or distributor side of a vendor relationship, as well as the vendor side
• Familiarity with how government agencies and education institutions are evaluating and adopting AI

The Distribution Control Center (DCC) is the hub that monitors and controls the electric distribution system, coordinates switching and restoration activities, as well as completes device commissioning and modeling to safely and reliably serve customers. In this critical, fast-paced role, you will play a key part in restoring power and supporting grid reliability by monitoring, analyzing, and managing outage events across Duke Energy’s distribution system. You will evaluate outage data, coordinate and direct field resources, and ensure accurate, real-time information is captured to support efficient restoration efforts at the feeder level and below. Working closely with the technical Grid Management team, Senior DCC Operators, and DCC Operations leadership, you will also assist in substation restoration as needed. You will be responsible for modeling work within OMS, DMS, and/or SCADA systems, and controlling the Distribution grid. A critical responsibility as the grid Control Authority includes the issuance of safety and operational tags such as HLTs, Clearance, Do Not Operate, and Information Tags. All switching and tagging activities under the distribution control authority will be fully managed by this role, to ensure safe and efficient response to planned and emergent work impacting the distribution grid. Successful candidates will thrive in high-pressure environments and are energized by problem-solving during critical events. You will play a vital role during abnormal conditions and large-scale outages, providing essential support and contributing to emergency and storm response operations. This role serves as vital support during abnormal or emergency events, requiring sound judgment and the ability to perform under pressure. This opportunity offers exposure to complex grid operations in a 24/7 environment, with rotational shifts and on-call responsibilities that directly support service reliability when it matters most. To be considered for this role, candidates must successfully pass the System Operator/Power Dispatching (SOPD) II test. Once selected for this role, all Operator I positions must successfully pass the Operator Training Certification program and progress to Operator II. The Operator Training Certification program typically takes eighteen to twenty-four months and consists of classroom instruction, on-the-job (OJT) training, and simulator training and assessments. Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Position Location:

Bloomington, IL; Atlanta, GA; Dallas, TX; or Phoenix, AZ

Hybrid Work Arrangement:

In this position, you should plan to spend time working in the office each week and remotely (with the ability for same-day travel to and from your assigned office location) as part of a hybrid work arrangement. Work arrangements could change over time based on business need. Your manager will share additional information regarding your department's approach and what it means for you.

Incumbency: There is a 12-month incumbency period (beginning on the employee's effective date) for any lateral job movements and a 12-month incumbency period for any promotional opportunities, which must be met before the employee may post for other State Farm positions. The incumbency period does not affect the at-will relationship between State Farm and the employee and does not create an employment contract, nor contractual rights.

*****Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity*****

Responsibilities

The State Farm P&C Actuarial & Underwriting Modeling (PCM) team is looking for an experienced NLP/Transformer Research Model Architect with deep expertise in transformer-based neural networks to join our innovative, dynamic, and fast-paced team of exceptional data science professionals. In this role, you'll apply cutting-edge NLP and deep learning research to real underwriting and pricing challenges — including modeling high-frequency time series data, extracting insight from unstructured text, and scaling transformer-based solutions efficiently within a resource-constrained production environment. You'll also play a key role in mentoring team members as they build design and experimentation skills in this space.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serves as a high-level consultant/researcher on department initiatives involving transformer-based neural networks and related deep learning architectures
• Designs, develops, fine-tunes, and deploys transformer models (e.g., attention mechanisms, encoder/decoder and encoder-only architectures, embeddings, transfer learning) for underwriting and pricing use cases, including modeling and forecasting on high-frequency time series data
• Designs and implements strategies to scale transformer-based solutions efficiently, optimizing for performance and cost within current compute and resource constraints
• Reviews and analyzes structured and unstructured data in innovative ways to refine underwriting, pricing, and risk selection objectives across the enterprise
• Identifies new data elements, criteria, or factors — including those derived from text, documents, high-frequency time series, and other unstructured or structured sources — for use in underwriting and pricing
• Conducts applied research studies in conjunction with other financial/research areas of the enterprise, staying current on state-of-the-art transformer and LLM research
• Mentors and trains other data scientists and modelers on the design, experimentation, and evaluation of transformer-based solutions, helping build internal capability in this space
• Consults with business clients on the use of modeling, machine learning, and AI, assessing needs and defining project scope
• Participates in external professional and industry committees/studies related to AI/ML and NLP
• Applies strong programming skills to build and productionize computer-intensive analysis techniques and model pipelines, with an eye toward scalability and efficient use of resources
• Routinely engages in quantitative analysis on non-standard and unique business problems
• Uses knowledge of business areas and research skills to address and solve a diverse range of real-world business issues

Qualifications

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

• 3-5 years of experience applying transformer-based neural networks and deep learning to real-world problems
• A Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Math, Actuarial Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required
• Hands-on experience with transformer architectures and techniques such as attention mechanisms, self-attention, embeddings, fine-tuning pretrained language models, and transfer learning
• Experience applying transformer-based or deep learning models to high-frequency time series data (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, or sequence modeling on densely sampled data)
• Experience scaling machine learning solutions in resource-constrained environments — e.g., model compression, distillation, quantization, efficient fine-tuning, or infrastructure/cost optimization
• Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and libraries such as Hugging Face Transformers
• Experience applying NLP/deep learning techniques to structured and unstructured business data; insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry experience is a plus
• Demonstrated experience mentoring or training other data scientists/engineers in model design and experimentation
• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex modeling concepts for non-technical business partners

Next Steps: Competitive candidates may be invited to participate in pre-employment on-demand video interviewing to kick off the interview process.

*****Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity*****

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

• Potential starting salary range: $190,000-$220,000

• Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience
• High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience

• Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary

At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

• Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.
• Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
• Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
• Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
• Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
• Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
• Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

jobs.description:
Moon Active is one of the world’s fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the globe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We’re looking for an experienced Application Security Researcher to join our Security team. As an Application Security Researcher, you’ll take an active role in guiding our development teams to ensure Moon Active’s mobile games are designed and implemented securely. You'll be helping manage Moon Active’s secure development lifecycle in our products that serve millions of users daily. In your role, you will help secure the company’s use of AI and enable its safe adoption across the organization. At the same time, you will use AI extensively in your own work to improve the effectiveness and impact of security.

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with the development teams to conduct design review, code review, and dynamic analysis.

- Identify, communicate and drive the resolution of vulnerabilities.

- Research and advocate for new security solutions and technologies.

- Continue to drive early security evaluation by conducting iterative security testing.

- Design and develop AI-powered internal security tools to automate security processes.

- Operate as an incident responder for triage pertaining to applicative vulnerabilities.

Requirements

- 3+ years of proven experience in AppSec research, including a deep understanding of major AppSec attacks, vulnerabilities and mitigations including SQL injection, Deserialization, RCE, etc or relevant military service.

- 3+ years of proven experience with high-level code auditing on backend or relevant military service.

- Familiarity with a wide range of programming languages (Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

- Hands-on experience in leveraging AI capabilities for Application Security.

- Deep understanding of how to secure AI-powered applications.

Advantages

- Experience with cloud environments - specifically AWS and GCP.

- Found a high-severity vulnerability in a popular app.

- Familiar with mobile application platforms and APIs like Google Play, App Store.
